study_design: Prospective cohort analysis within the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study, with baseline serum measurement and 28 years of follow-up.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We conducted a biochemical analysis of 29,102 male Finnish smokers in the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study.
reason: The abstract evaluates incident prostate cancer overall and does not identify an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incidence endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: No association was observed between serum α-tocopherol and prostate cancer risk (fifth quintile (Q5) vs. Q1 hazard ratio (HR) = 0.87, 95% confidence interval (95% CI) 0.75, 1.02; P-trend = 0.57).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is for overall incident prostate cancer without an aggressive disease definition.
